# TPC-DS-OBT Q59

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH wss AS (SELECT obt.sold_date_d_week_seq, obt.store_sk, obt.store_s_store_name, obt.store_s_store_id, obt.sold_date_d_month_seq, SUM(CASE WHEN (obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Sunday') THEN obt.sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sun_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Monday') THEN obt.sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS mon_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Tuesday') THEN obt.sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS tue_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Wednesday') THEN obt.sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS wed_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Thursday') THEN obt.sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS thu_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Friday') THEN obt.sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS fri_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN (obt.sold_date_d_day_name = 'Saturday') THEN obt.sales_price ELSE NULL END) AS sat_sales FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE obt.sold_date_d_date_sk = obt.sold_date_sk AND channel = 'store' GROUP BY obt.sold_date_d_week_seq, obt.store_sk, obt.store_s_store_name, obt.store_s_store_id, obt.sold_date_d_month_seq) SELECT s_store_name1 AS store_s_store_name, s_store_id1 AS store_s_store_id, d_week_seq1, CAST(sun_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(sun_sales2, 0), CAST(mon_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(mon_sales2, 0), CAST(tue_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(tue_sales2, 0), CAST(wed_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(wed_sales2, 0), CAST(thu_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(thu_sales2, 0), CAST(fri_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(fri_sales2, 0), CAST(sat_sales1 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(sat_sales2, 0) FROM (SELECT wss.store_s_store_name AS s_store_name1, wss.sold_date_d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1, wss.store_s_store_id AS s_store_id1, sun_sales AS sun_sales1, mon_sales AS mon_sales1, tue_sales AS tue_sales1, wed_sales AS wed_sales1, thu_sales AS thu_sales1, fri_sales AS fri_sales1, sat_sales AS sat_sales1 FROM wss WHERE wss.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11) AS y, (SELECT wss.store_s_store_name AS s_store_name2, wss.sold_date_d_week_seq AS d_week_seq2, wss.store_s_store_id AS s_store_id2, sun_sales AS sun_sales2, mon_sales AS mon_sales2, tue_sales AS tue_sales2, wed_sales AS wed_sales2, thu_sales AS thu_sales2, fri_sales AS fri_sales2, sat_sales AS sat_sales2 FROM wss WHERE wss.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 + 12 AND 1176 + 23) AS x WHERE s_store_id1 = s_store_id2 AND d_week_seq1 = d_week_seq2 - 52 ORDER BY store_s_store_name, store_s_store_id, d_week_seq1 LIMIT 100
```
